title: Meaning of Abeokuta
fact: "Abeokuta" literally translates in Yoruba to "Under the Rock", named after the sacred shelter provided by Olumo Rock to the Egba settlers in 1830.

title: Birthplace of Nigerian Journalism
fact: In 1859, Nigeria’s very first newspaper, "Iwe Irohin Yoruba", was established right here in Abeokuta by Henry Townsend.

title: Global Capital of Adire
fact: Itoku and Kemta markets in Abeokuta supply genuine handcrafted indigo resist-dyed textiles across West Africa, Europe, and America.

title: Rich Chieftaincy Tradition
fact: The Alake of Egbaland presides over four historic Egba federations, harmonizing centuries of heritage with modern community leadership.
